title: Old Windowsill
diary: I walked past my old apartment today. Someone else's plants on the windowsill. I didn't feel sad, just quiet. Places outgrow us before we outgrow them.

title: Train Confessions
diary: Told a stranger on the train about my week and then felt lighter. Maybe anonymity is its own kind of kindness.

title: Out Loud, To No One
diary: I keep pretending I'm not tired. Today I admitted it, out loud, to no one. The admitting was the rest.

title: Tea I Didn't Drink
diary: Made tea I didn't drink. Sat with the warmth in my hands. Some comforts aren't meant to be consumed.

title: Shower Tears
diary: Cried in the shower, which is the only place my body lets me. Afterwards I made toast and it tasted like everything I'd been holding in.

title: The Unsent Text
diary: I almost texted them. Closed the app. Opened it. Closed it again. That's a kind of growth, I think.

title: 4pm Light
diary: Noticed the light at 4pm slanting through the blinds and felt something I couldn't name. Nostalgia for a day that hadn't ended yet.

title: Three Fears, On Paper
diary: I wrote down three things I'm afraid of. Looked at them. Two of them were smaller on paper than in my head.

title: The Bird and the Window
diary: A bird kept trying to fly into my window. I stood there for a long time wondering if it saw something beautiful or just its own reflection.

title: A Coat Put Down
diary: Forgave myself for something small today. Realized I'd been carrying it for months. Put it down like a coat I'd forgotten was heavy.
